svg.title: Health care and social assistance added 3.8 million jobs from January 2022 to September 2026, the most of any industry; information and the federal government lost jobs.
svg.desc: Sixteen small area charts of payroll jobs from January 2022 to September 2026, on one scale of percent change, each with all nonfarm jobs, up 6.0 percent, as a gray line. Health care and social assistance gained the most, 3.8 million jobs or 18.8 percent; information lost 245,000 jobs, 8.2 percent, and the federal government lost 197,000, 6.8 percent.
svg.text: Gray line in every panel: all nonfarm jobs, +6.0%
